definition: A list of one or more case submitter_ids associated with this data.
The submitter_id or id of the case this condition describes, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.
The code for a specific condition, assigned by the code system.
The system that assigned the code for a specific condition.
The name of the condition the patient has experienced.
A combination of date and time of day in the form [-]CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm]

The number of days from the index date to the date the subject no longer experienced the condition. This property is included to ensure personal privacy protection in accordance with the HIPAA Safe Harbor Method. More information can be found here https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/special-topics/de-identification/index.html.

The number of days from the index date to the date the subject was diagnosed with or began experiencing the condition. This property is included to ensure personal privacy protection in accordance with the HIPAA Safe Harbor Method. More information can be found here https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/special-topics/de-identification/index.html.
The number of days from the index date to the date the symptoms began.
An indicator confirming whether the patient received a diagnosis of fibrosis.
A visual measure of the involvement of fibrosis in the lungs.
A visual measure of the volume loss or shrinkage of the lungs due to fibrosis.
An indicator confirming a history of connective tissue disease.
A description of the type of connective tissue disease.
An indicator confirming a history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
A description of the type of HIV treatment received.
An indicator confirming a history of interstitial lung disease.
An indicator confirming a history of lung cancer.
A description of the confirmed history of other diseases not previously listed.
The indicator related to medical history of the condition tuberculosis (TB).
A description of the type of tuberculosis treatment received.

A 128-bit identifier. Depending on the mechanism used to generate it, it is either guaranteed to be different from all other UUIDs/GUIDs generated until 3400 AD or extremely likely to be different. Its relatively small size lends itself well to sorting, ordering, and hashing of all sorts, storing in databases, simple allocation, and ease of programming in general.
A description noting the presenting symptoms at the onset of the condition.
Unique ID for any specific defined piece of work that is undertaken or attempted to meet a single requirement.
The current state of the object.
A human-readable, unique identifier for a record in the metadata database. It can be used in place of the UUID for identifying or recalling a record (e.g., in data queries or uploads/exports).
The node_id of the node in the data model; the name of the node used in queries and API requests (e.g., "aligned_reads_file" for the "Aligned Reads File" node).
A combination of date and time of day in the form [-]CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm]
Version of the submitting theranostics extension, independently of the MIDRC baseline version.
Record curation state, independent of clinical value.
Identifier of the originating source record; use an approved pseudonym when needed.
Source system or data provider.
Names of properties missing from this record; no missing value is encoded as zero.
Reasons corresponding by index to missing_properties.
ISO 8601 assessment datetime; use approved date shifting consistently within the case.
Signed elapsed days from the linked therapy course start.
Interpretation of stored dates and elapsed times.
Beginning of assessment window relative to course start, in days.
End of assessment window relative to course start, in days.
Metastasis stage (M) based on AJCC staging system version 9 at the time of initial prostate cancer diagnosis.
Nodal stage (N) based on  AJCC staging system version 9at the time of initial prostate cancer diagnosis.
Overall AJCC stage group at the time of initial prostate cancer diagnosis. Specify AJCC version used.
Tumor stage (T) based on  AJCC staging system version 9at the time of initial prostate cancer diagnosis.
Date when the patient's prostate cancer was deemed castration-resistant.
Patient's disease status regarding hormone sensitivity at the time of assessment.
Date when the hormone sensitivity status was determined or assessed.
ISUP Gleason Grade Group from primary prostate cancer diagnosis.
Gleason score from primary prostate cancer diagnosis.
Specific histological subtype or features, particularly noting adenocarcinoma vs. neuroendocrine differentiation or aggressive variants.
Date when prostate cancer was first diagnosed.
Presence or absence of lymph-vascular invasion identified in pathology report (typically from primary tumor).
Location(s) of metastatic disease at baseline prior to PSMA theranostics.
Microsatellite instability status (e.g., MSI-High, MSI-Low, MSS-Stable), if tested.
Provisional field for Baseline clinical data; Hormone sensitive prostate ca; operational definition requires review.
Provisional field for Castrate resistant prostate Ca; operational definition requires review.
